title: How a Ten-Second Pause Builds a Godly Man Who Isn't Run by His Impulses
caption:
The reply you want to send at 11 PM. The purchase before payday. The comment on her post. You already know your triggers, and naming them ahead of time is half the fight.

Count to ten before your hands move. Not as a trick. As a door. Ten seconds is long enough for the Spirit to get a word in before your flesh does.

Self-control is a fruit, not a personality trait. Galatians lists it right after love and patience. It grows. It was never something you either have or don't.

Practice the pause on the small stuff so it holds when it's big.

#faith #selfcontrol #godlyman #christianmen #fruitofthespirit
theme: He runs his life — his impulses don't control him.
